online.title: Company | ChronoAI
online.text: ChronoAI Accelerate the discovery of truth. We pursue verifiable research and build tools for people to work with AI agents. Our work connects two ambitions: asking better questions and making it practical to act on them. Pause animation Direction is part of the work. Our view is that greater execution capacity makes judgment more important. People choose the questions, define the conditions and decide what is worth pursuing. AI helps carry the work forward; explicit checks help us evaluate the result. QuestionConditionsChecks A connected body of work. trureturingOur research: questions, assumptions, recorded results and limits. NyxIDConnects agents to services. NyxBot is the main agent inside NyxID. OrnnA place to find and share agent skills. CMAChronoAI Managed Agent: persistent agents in the cloud. heca Coming soonOrchestration for agent work. chrono-harnessGovernance for agent workflows — a Rust harness for explicit registrations and scoped checks. Public beta. Each project has its own scope and availability. Source-code availability is recorded per project. Make the claim precise. Research becomes useful when readers can see the question, the assumptions, the result and the limits. Two examples from trureturing: a recorded counterexample shows that a plausible floor formula for OEIS A175406 fails; and an entropy identity relates von Neumann entropy to quantum relative entropy — under explicitly stated conditions, and without claiming unconditional entropy increase. We distinguish Lean-checked results, paper proofs and open questions. The scope of a result belongs beside the result. Lean-checked resultPaper proofOpen question Explore trureturing → Make the work inspectable. 01Start with a question. 02State the assumptions. 03Inspect the evidence. 04Decide what to test next. We look for people who can bring questions and exercise judgment. A useful contribution leaves others something they can examine and build on. Selected public records. Read the snapshot ↗ chrono-harnessPublic beta documentation — the documented scope and implementation limits. View the repository ↗ The snapshot date marks when the reading site was built, not a launch or founding date. Bring a question worth pursuing. online.title: Research | ChronoAI
online.text: Research · trureturing A truth-discovery library. If machine learning is a logical black box, trureturing aims to be a logical white box. Definitions, assumptions, proof steps and dependencies make reasoning inspectable. Explore the library ↗View on GitHub ↗ Pause animation How a result gets recorded. 01QuestionName what needs to be understood. 02DefinitionsFix the objects and terms. 03AssumptionsState the conditions explicitly. 04Proof checkCheck the steps — in Lean where formalized. 05RecordKeep the result beside its scope. Follow a question ObservationWhat can an observation tell us?Educational example: four states and the questions they can and cannot separate.Read ↗ CounterexampleWhen does a formula break?A recorded counterexample to a stated floor formula for OEIS A175406.Read ↗ QuantumWhat can local data miss?A finite quantum model: different global states with the same local marginals.Read ↗ Open problemsWhat does the record call resolved?External problem dossiers and what “resolved” means in the record.Read ↗ Research with a record. CounterexampleA plausible formula can fail.The record gives a counterexample to the stated floor formula for OEIS A175406.Read the claim and counterexample ↗ Quantum informationAn entropy identity under stated conditions.For a specified basis measurement, the record relates von Neumann entropy to quantum relative entropy when the target logarithm is diagonal in that basis. This does not establish unconditional entropy increase.Read the assumptions and proof record ↗ Scope matters.A proof establishes a formal statement under its assumptions. Its match to an external research question requires separate review. Open questions and experiments keep their own limits. “All logic can be formalized” is the guiding conviction — not a universal theorem or a completed capability. Lean-checked resultPaper proofOpen question From research to tools. The same habit — explicit conditions, checkable results — shapes the infrastructure we build for AI agents.
